jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring a Engineering Lead to build the systems that help our clinical teams deliver services in the field and in members’ homes. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation.

A likely first assignment is an “Air Traffic Control” system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene.

This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable.

We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day.

As an  Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations, you will:

  • Work directly with supervisors, clinical field staff, and operations leaders to understand schedules, travel, capacity, handoffs, and the exceptions that disrupt a day’s work.
  • Build field visibility and intervention tools that give supervisors useful context, distinguish current facts from missing information, and help them respond to changing conditions.
  • Develop scheduling and dispatch capabilities that match people and visits to practical constraints, with clear ways for operating staff to review and adjust the plan.
  • Build and debug APIs, mobile workflows, integrations, and data flows supporting field teams, connected equipment, and home technology.
  • Prototype quickly and ship focused increments. Make deliberate choices about what to build, integrate, or buy, and avoid committing to a large system before the operation has tested the approach.
  • Use AI actively for development, investigation, prototypes, analysis, and useful workflow capabilities. Check the behavior and make failures understandable and recoverable.
  • Coach engineers and take on a small number of direct reports as the team develops. Maintain clear ownership, sound engineering practices, and credible delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Product, Special Project Leads, IT, Counterpart, and the Engagement lead at the interfaces their work shares with field operations.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand how the field operation works, have shipped an improvement used by supervisors or field staff, and can show what it changed. You have a focused technical plan grounded in real constraints and exceptions.
  • First six months: Several useful increments are in place. Supervisors can understand and respond to disruptions more effectively, scheduling and field workflows are improving, and technical ownership is clear.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has owned meaningful work end-to-end and still builds regularly.
  • You can move across backend services, APIs, data flows, user interfaces, and operational workflows to solve a real problem.
  • You have strong product instincts, learn unfamiliar domains directly, and enjoy working with the people using what you build.
  • You have an iterative, curious approach to technology. You can describe an unfamiliar system you explored, a practical prototype you tried, or a failure you traced across boundaries.
  • You use AI in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities, with clear verification and evaluation.
  • You can coach engineers and are interested in responsibility for a small team as it develops. Formal management experience can help, but a strong record of Engineering Leadership and coaching also matters.

jobs.title: Datadog: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
jobs.description:
Headquarters: California, USA, Remote

As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise.

This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first
  • Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket
  • Lead discovery inside flat, engineering-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on
  • Run full-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely
  • Act as an extension of the customer’s engineering/observability team rather than an external operator - this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break
  • Work Slack-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask
  • Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near-real-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it
  • Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second - savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener
  • Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last
  • Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current

 

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome
  • Hands-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each
  • Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP)
  • Comfortable in flat organizations - able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy
  • Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits
  • Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth - scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly
  • Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt
  • Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one
  • Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement
  • Willing to travel for multi-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth: 

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training

Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote)

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.

jobs.description:

Our mission is to strengthen the relationship between patients and physicians by creating clinical-first technology that supports value-based care and streamlines clinician workflows.

Serving thousands of independent practices, medical groups, and risk-bearing entities across the country, Elation helps providers deliver exceptional care while meeting the operational and financial demands of modern healthcare.

This role is centered on enabling providers and their teams to fully adopt and maximize Elation Health's platform through hands-on training, live and virtual instruction, and ongoing workflow consultation. The ideal candidate brings deep cultural competency and fluency in Korean and English, building lasting trust within the communities we serve.

You'll serve as the primary training and workflow resource embedded within our enterprise partner ecosystem, running structured training sessions, developing practice-specific workflows, and ensuring providers confidently adopt Elation. Expect 100% on-the-ground presence across partner sites, clinics, and community events.

 

This is a part-time contract role (30 hours/week) with a three-month review.

 

Responsibilities

Training Delivery — Live & Virtual

  • Design and lead bilingual (Korean and English) onboarding and training sessions for providers, clinical staff, and practice administrators across enterprise partner networks.
  • Deliver both in-person training at practice sites and structured virtual sessions via video conferencing tools.
  • Build and maintain a library of training materials, workflows, quick reference guides, and session recordings in both languages.
  • Run role-specific training tracks for physicians, MAs, front desk, and practice managers, ensuring each stakeholder understands their workflow within Elation.
  • Facilitate group training workshops, one-on-one coaching sessions, and refresher trainings post-go-live.

Workflow Consultation

  • Partner with practices to assess current workflows and map them to Elation's clinical platform, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide tailored workflow recommendations that align with each practice's specialty, care model, and value-based care requirements.
  • Guide providers through best practices for clinical documentation, care gap workflows, quality measure tracking, and EHR utilization.
  • Collaborate with implementation and customer success teams to ensure workflow designs are scalable and sustainable.

Community & Provider Engagement

  • Represent Elation Health at local provider events, workshops, and seminars, educating providers about the platform and building awareness of Elation's capabilities.
  • Engage directly with providers and healthcare communities to build trust and credibility through culturally resonant communication.
  • Act as a visible, trusted face of Elation in the field, attending partner-hosted events, IPA meetings, and provider roundtables.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Provider Relations and Engagement leads to coordinate training schedules and prioritize high-need practices.
  • Provide structured feedback from the field on provider workflow challenges, training gaps, and adoption barriers to inform product and go-to-market strategy.
  • Coordinate with implementation teams to maintain continuity from go-live through post-launch workflow stabilization.

Onboarding & Adoption Support

  • Maintain active involvement through the onboarding period, serving as the primary training contact for practices in their first 30–90 days on Elation.
  • Track training completion, session attendance, and post-training adoption metrics across the practice portfolio.
  • Escalate adoption risks to Customer Success or Implementation leadership with documented context and a recommended action plan.

Performance & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of training delivery, session attendance, workflow assessments, and provider feedback in CRM and project management tools.
  • Report on training KPIs including session completion rates, provider satisfaction scores, and adoption velocity by practice cohort

Your primary duties will include handling incoming patient inquiries, providing administrative assistance to clinicians, and executing patient engagement and retention initiatives.

This role requires availability Saturday, Sunday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with scheduled hours of 1:00 PM to 12:00 AM Eastern Time.

What You'll Do

  • Provide courteous and professional assistance to customers via phone, email, and chat, addressing inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, rescheduling appointments, and providing solutions in a timely manner.
  • Educate customers on the features, functionalities, and benefits of our Cadence technology products and services, empowering them to maximize medical device usage.
  • Conduct follow-up communication with customers to ensure their issues have been resolved satisfactorily, gather feedback on their experience, and provide additional assistance if needed.
  • Appropriately escalate patient concerns to the necessary care delivery teams, ensuring that complex issues are addressed promptly and efficiently.
  • Execute patient engagement and retention initiatives across the Cadence remote monitoring program.

Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Money

The Money Team owns the financial infrastructure that underpins every dollar and crypto asset that moves through Gemini. We build and operate the ledger platform — the system of record for all crypto and fiat balances, settlements, fees, rewards, and administrative adjustments — as well as the payments services and reconciliation pipelines that connect Gemini to banks, payment rails, and external partners.

Our systems are relied upon by finance, compliance, treasury, and regulatory reporting. Correctness is non-negotiable. If something is ambiguous, we clarify it. If something is manual, we automate it. If something is unsafe, we fix it.

The Role: Senior Software Engineer

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a team of ledger and financial infrastructure engineers designing, building, and operating core money-movement systems at scale. You'll work on services that must handle high transaction volumes, evolve safely as new products and partners are introduced, and remain easy to operate and audit.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, deploy, and support ledger and payments services that accurately record all crypto and fiat money movement across the platform. 
  • Build and evolve bank settlement and reconciliation pipelines that connect Gemini to external payment rails and banking partners. 
  • Apply sound engineering principles to identify correctness, consistency, and operational risks — and implement safeguards in software before they become incidents.
  • Partner with finance, reconciliation, and treasury teams to understand real-world workflows and translate them into robust, auditable system behavior. 
  • Design scalable APIs and data models that support new transaction types, products, and regulatory requirements without increasing operational burden. 
  • Write well-tested, production-grade code that other critical systems depend on.
  • Monitor and communicate the health of ledger and payment systems, proactively identify issues, and participate in incident response and remediation.
  • Mentor teammates to ensure new functionality is correct, auditable, and production-ready.
  • Participate in on-call rotations as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience building backend systems in a production environment.
  • Strong experience designing and operating distributed, stateful systems where data integrity is critical. 
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language — we primarily use Scala and Go, but are open to candidates willing to learn. 
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Ability to reason about and debug complex system behavior across services and data stores.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on ledger systems, accounting platforms, payments infrastructure, or financial transaction processing. 
  • Familiarity with double-entry bookkeeping, reconciliation processes, audit requirements, or regulatory reporting. 
  • Experience integrating with external payment rails or banking partners (ACH, wire, card networks). 
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration systems (e.g. Temporal, Cadence) for durable, retryable financial processes. 
  • Background in fintech or financial services.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Reddit’s Product Catalogs team. Your team will build intuitive UIs, robust APIs, and scalable backend systems for catalog ingestion, storage, and product data management.

These systems power Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) and organic shopping, connecting users with relevant products in the context of their interests and conversations. Someone browsing r/golf might discover popular golf clubs, while someone reading a discussion about sunglasses in r/BuyItForLife might see the exact models being discussed. In this role, you will set technical direction, develop engineers, and drive execution across the catalog platform and advertiser experience. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to understand customer needs and make catalog onboarding and management seamless.
